mapper.select: SELECT id, login_id, password_hash, auth_version, display_name, role, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM member WHERE login_id = #{loginId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id, login_id, password_hash, auth_version, display_name, role, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM member WHERE id = #{memberId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM member_sanction WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND starts_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND ( ends_at IS NULL OR ends_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member ( login_id, password_hash, display_name, role ) VALUES ( #{loginId}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{role} )
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET display_name = #{displayName}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{memberId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE member SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, auth_version = auth_version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{memberId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND auth_version = #{expectedAuthVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post WHERE author_id = #{memberId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT p.id, b.slug AS boardSlug, b.name AS boardName, b.status AS boardStatus, p.title, p.is_secret AS secret, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.created_at AS createdAt FROM post p JOIN board b ON b.id = p.board_id WHERE p.author_id = #{memberId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment WHERE author_id = #{memberId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT c.id, c.post_id AS postId, c.parent_id AS parentId, b.slug AS boardSlug, b.name AS boardName, b.status AS boardStatus, (p.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AS postDeleted, c.content, c.created_at AS createdAt FROM comment c JOIN post p ON p.id = c.post_id JOIN board b ON b.id = p.board_id WHERE c.author_id = #{memberId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
